measured.contract: keeps every bone, animation, attachment and bodypart of the base

M1.reason: Front/back (0.814) and left/right (0.842) clear 0.80, but top/below measures 0.791, under the 0.80 line, so 2 is not allowed. The pictures show why: the original's bulky pouch-laden vest and chunky laced boots are replaced by a slimmer plain vest and flat block feet, and the reproduction's depth is narrower (22.4 vs 24.5).

M2.reason: Length 24.4 vs 23.9 (+2.1%), width 22.4 vs 24.5 (-8.4%), height 70.1 vs 70.1 (0%). All are within 10%.

M3.reason: The main components are there and in place: balaclava, black vest, gloves, belt, knee pads, thigh pockets and boots. But the original's vest front carries many raised pouches and straps, and the reproduction has a flat front with only a zipper line. The original's boots are laced combat boots; the reproduction's are flat rectangular blocks. The original's elbow pads and the gear at its belt are reduced or missing.

M4.reason: The measured mean dE is 9.6, under 15, and the mask, vest, gloves and boots are the right black. The trousers and sleeves are not the same colour, though: the original's are a dark, dirty olive-brown, and the reproduction's are a clearly lighter, cleaner tan/khaki, visible in every view. The reproduction also has orange eye glints in the mask opening (front, left, right) that the original's dark eye area does not show.

M5.reason: The back emblem is there, but as a bright, crisp white bird where the original has a faint grey trident-eagle with lettering. The reproduction adds a white zipper stripe on the vest front. It lacks the original's grime and wear on the trousers, the pouch and strap detail on the vest, the metallic shine of the knee pads, the boot laces and the fabric folds. Its surfaces are flat fills with a few dark bands at the knees.

M6.reason: At game size it reads as the same kind of masked operator in a black vest and khaki, but a player would not take it for the original. The light, flat tan legs and arms against the original's dark grimy fatigues, the block feet, the plain vest and the bright back logo make it look like a different, cleaner skin.

M7.reason: It faces the same way in every view, stands upright, and its feet sit on the same ground line as the original's, with the same height.

M8.reason: There are no check errors. It has 1604 triangles against the original's 2617, under twice. No open, inside-out or floating parts are visible in any view or frame.

C1.reason: Through the run (frames 4 to 30) and the forward dive (5 to 35) every part stays attached. Limbs, head, vest and pads follow the original's poses frame for frame, and nothing separates, sinks below the ground line or floats.

C2.reason: The measured contract reports that it keeps every bone, animation, attachment and bodypart of the base, with no faults. The dive_f_akimbo stunt plays at the same frames as the original's.
